# from langflow.base.data.utils import IMG_FILE_TYPES, TEXT_FILE_TYPES
from langflow.base.io.chat import ChatComponent
from langflow.inputs import BoolInput
from langflow.io import (
    DropdownInput,
    # FileInput,
    MessageTextInput,
    MultilineInput,
    Output,
)
from langflow.schema.message import Message
from langflow.utils.constants import (
    MESSAGE_SENDER_AI,
    MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_USER,
    MESSAGE_SENDER_USER,
)


class ChatInput(ChatComponent):
    display_name = "Chat Input"
    description = "Get chat inputs from the Playground."
    icon = "MessagesSquare"
    name = "ChatInput"
    minimized = True

    inputs = [
        MultilineInput(
            name="input_value",
            display_name="Text",
            value="",
            info="Message to be passed as input.",
            input_types=[],
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="should_store_message",
            display_name="Store Messages",
            info="Store the message in the history.",
            value=False,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        DropdownInput(
            name="sender",
            display_name="Sender Type",
            options=[MESSAGE_SENDER_AI, MESSAGE_SENDER_USER],
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_USER,
            info="Type of sender.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="sender_name",
            display_name="Sender Name",
            info="Name of the sender.",
            value=MESSAGE_SENDER_NAME_USER,
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="session_id",
            display_name="Session ID",
            info="The session ID of the chat. If empty, the current session ID parameter will be used.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        # FileInput(
        #     name="files",
        #     display_name="Files",
        #     file_types=TEXT_FILE_TYPES + IMG_FILE_TYPES,
        #     info="Files to be sent with the message.",
        #     advanced=True,
        #     is_list=True,
        #     temp_file=True,
        # ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="background_color",
            display_name="Background Color",
            info="The background color of the icon.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="chat_icon",
            display_name="Icon",
            info="The icon of the message.",
            advanced=True,
        ),
        MessageTextInput(
            name="text_color",
            display_name="Text Color",
            info="The text color of the name",
            advanced=True,
        ),
    ]
    outputs = [
        Output(display_name="Message", name="message", method="message_response"),
    ]

    async def message_response(self) -> Message:
        background_color = self.background_color
        text_color = self.text_color
        icon = self.chat_icon

        message = await Message.create(
            text=self.input_value,
            sender=self.sender,
            sender_name=self.sender_name,
            session_id=self.session_id,
            flow_id=self.graph.flow_id if hasattr(self, "graph") else None,
            # files=self.files,
            files=None,
            properties={
                "background_color": background_color,
                "text_color": text_color,
                "icon": icon,
            },
        )
        if self.session_id and isinstance(message, Message):
            if self.should_store_message:
                stored_message = await self.send_message(message)
                self.message.value = stored_message
                message = stored_message
            else:
                await self.send_message_without_storage(message)
                self.message.value = message

        self.status = message
        return message

If empty, the current session ID parameter will be used.", advanced=True, ), MessageTextInput( name="data_template", display_name="Data Template", value="{text}", advanced=True, info="Template to convert Data to Text. Handle case where source is a ChatOpenAI object if hasattr(source, "model_name"): source_dict["source"] = source.model_name elif hasattr(source, "model"): source_dict["source"] = str(source.model) else: source_dict["source"] = str(source) return Source(**source_dict) async def message_response(self) -> Message: # First convert the input to string if needed text = self.convert_to_string() # Keep generator separate from message.text from collections.abc import Generator, AsyncIterator, Iterator if isinstance(text, Generator | AsyncIterator | Iterator): text = "" # Empty string prevents consumption in send_message_without_storage # Get source properties source, icon, display_name, source_id, vertex_type = self.get_extended_properties_from_source_component() background_color = self.background_color text_color = self.text_color if self.chat_icon: icon = self.chat_icon # Create or use existing Message object # If the source is 'ChatInput', create a new message so that both the input and the output are displayed as separate messages in the chat if vertex_type == 'ChatInput' or not isinstance(self.input_value, Message): message = Message(text=text) else: message = self.input_value # Update message properties message.text = text # Set message properties message.sender = self.sender message.sender_name = self.sender_name message.session_id = self.session_id message.flow_id = self.graph.flow_id if hasattr(self, "graph") else None message.properties.source = self._build_source(source_id, display_name, source) message.properties.icon = icon message.properties.background_color = background_color message.properties.text_color = text_color # Store message if needed if self.session_id: if self.should_store_message: stored_message = await self.send_message(message) self.message.value = stored_message message = stored_message else: await self.send_message_without_storage(message) self.message.value = message self.status = message return message def _validate_input(self) -> None: """Validate the input data and raise ValueError if invalid.""" if self.input_value is None: msg = "Input data cannot be None" raise ValueError(msg) if isinstance(self.input_value, list) and not all( isinstance(item, Message | Data | DataFrame | str) for item in self.input_value ): invalid_types = [ type(item).__name__ for item in self.input_value if not isinstance(item, Message | Data | DataFrame | str) ] msg = f"Expected Data or DataFrame or Message or str, got {invalid_types}" raise TypeError(msg) if not isinstance( self.input_value, Message | Data | DataFrame | str | list | Generator | type(None), ): type_name = type(self.input_value).__name__ msg = f"Expected Data or DataFrame or Message or str, Generator or None, got {type_name}" raise TypeError(msg) def _safe_convert(self, data: Any) -> str: """Safely convert input data to string.""" try: if isinstance(data, str): return data if isinstance(data, Message): return data.get_text() if isinstance(data, Data): if data.get_text() is None: msg = "Empty Data object" raise ValueError(msg) return data.get_text() if isinstance(data, DataFrame): if self.clean_data: # Remove empty rows data = data.dropna(how="all") # Remove empty lines in each cell data = data.replace(r"^\s*$", "", regex=True) # Replace multiple newlines with a single newline data = data.replace(r"\n+", "\n", regex=True) # Replace pipe characters to avoid markdown table issues processed_data = data.replace(r"\|", r"\\|", regex=True) processed_data = processed_data.map( lambda x: str(x).replace("\n", "
") if isinstance(x, str) else x ) return processed_data.to_markdown(index=False) return str(data) except (ValueError, TypeError, AttributeError) as e: msg = f"Error converting data: {e!s}" raise ValueError(msg) from e def convert_to_string(self) -> str | Generator[Any, None, None]: """Convert input data to string with proper error handling.""" self._validate_input() if isinstance(self.input_value, list): return "\n".join([self._safe_convert(item) for item in self.input_value]) if isinstance(self.input_value, Generator): return self.input_value return self._safe_convert(self.input_value)

import json
from langchain_openai import ChatOpenAI
from pydantic.v1 import SecretStr
from loguru import logger

from langflow.base.models.model import LCModelComponent
from langflow.field_typing import LanguageModel
from langflow.field_typing.range_spec import RangeSpec
from langflow.inputs import BoolInput, DictInput, IntInput, SliderInput, CredentialInput
from langflow.gen_ai.utils.models import get_models
from langflow.gen_ai.credential.credential_manager import CredentialsManager
from langflow.gen_ai.utils.formatter.api_url_formatter import OpenaiUrlFormatter
from langflow.gen_ai.credential.filter import get_filter_policies
from langflow.interface.components import update_all_cached_components_template


class OpenAIModelComponent(LCModelComponent):
    display_name = "OpenAI"
    description = "Generates text using OpenAI LLMs."
    icon = "OpenAI"
    name = "OpenAIModel"
    provider_name: str = "OpenAI"
    service_type: str = "SERVICE_TYPE_01"
    models = get_models(provider_name=provider_name, service_type=service_type)

    inputs = [
        *LCModelComponent._base_inputs,
        IntInput(
            name="max_tokens",
            display_name="Max Tokens",
            advanced=True,
            info="The maximum number of tokens to generate. Set to 0 for unlimited tokens.",
            range_spec=RangeSpec(min=0, max=128000),
        ),
        DictInput(
            name="model_kwargs",
            display_name="Model Kwargs",
            advanced=True,
            info="Additional keyword arguments to pass to the model.",
        ),
        BoolInput(
            name="json_mode",
            display_name="JSON Mode",
            advanced=True,
            info="If True, it will output JSON regardless of passing a schema.",
        ),
        CredentialInput(
            name="credential",
            provider_name=provider_name,
            display_name="Credential",
            advanced=False,
            options=models,
            refresh_button=True,
            required=True,
        ),
        SliderInput(
            name="temperature",
            display_name="Temperature",
            value=0.1,
            range_spec=RangeSpec(min=0, max=1, step=0.01),
            advanced=True,
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="seed",
            display_name="Seed",
            info="The seed controls the reproducibility of the job.",
            advanced=True,
            value=1,
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="max_retries",
            display_name="Max Retries",
            info="The maximum number of retries to make when generating.",
            advanced=True,
            value=5,
        ),
        IntInput(
            name="timeout",
            display_name="Timeout",
            info="The timeout for requests to OpenAI completion API.",
            advanced=True,
            value=700,
        ),
    ]

    def update_build_config(self, build_config: dict, field_value: str, field_name: str | None = None):
        if field_name == "credential":
            # Force refresh when credential is updated (e.g., refresh button clicked)
            models = get_models(provider_name=self.provider_name, service_type=self.service_type, use_cache=False)
            build_config["credential"]["options"] = models
            build_config["credential"]["provider_name"] = self.provider_name
        elif field_name == "filter_input":
            filter_options = get_filter_policies().get("input")
            build_config["filter_input"]["options"] = filter_options

            # Update cache for filter_input changes
            update_all_cached_components_template({
                "filter_input": {
                    "options": filter_options
                }
            })
        elif field_name == "filter_output":
            filter_options = get_filter_policies().get("output")
            build_config["filter_output"]["options"] = filter_options

            # Update cache for filter_output changes
            update_all_cached_components_template({
                "filter_output": {
                    "options": filter_options
                }
            })
        return build_config

    def build_model(self) -> LanguageModel:  # type: ignore[type-var]
        temperature = self.temperature
        max_tokens = self.max_tokens
        model_kwargs = self.model_kwargs or {}
        json_mode = self.json_mode
        seed = self.seed
        max_retries = self.max_retries
        timeout = self.timeout

        # credential이 문자열인 경우 JSON 파싱
        credential_raw = self.credential or {}
        logger.debug(f"[DEBUG] build_model: credential_raw type={type(credential_raw)}, value={credential_raw}")
        
        if isinstance(credential_raw, str):
            try:
                credential: dict[str, str] = json.loads(credential_raw)
                logger.debug(f"[DEBUG] build_model: Parsed credential from JSON string: {credential}")
            except (json.JSONDecodeError, TypeError) as e:
                logger.error(
                    f"[DEBUG] build_model: Failed to parse credential JSON string: {credential_raw}, error: {e}"
                )
                credential = {}
        elif isinstance(credential_raw, dict):
            credential = credential_raw
            logger.debug(f"[DEBUG] build_model: credential is already dict: {credential}")
        else:
            logger.warning(
                f"[DEBUG] build_model: Unexpected credential type: {type(credential_raw)}, value: {credential_raw}"
            )
            credential = {}
        
        logger.debug(
            f"[DEBUG] build_model: Final credential_dict: {credential}, "
            f"serviceId: {credential.get('serviceId')}, "
            f"credentialId: {credential.get('credentialId')}, "
            f"serviceName: {credential.get('serviceName')}"
        )

        # TODO: credential extraction
        credential_cls = CredentialsManager().update_credential(
            provider_name=self.provider_name, credential_dict=credential, component=self
        )
        openai_api_key = credential_cls.variables[0].attribute_value
        openai_api_base = credential_cls.get_api_base(url_formatter=OpenaiUrlFormatter())
        ###

        api_key = SecretStr(openai_api_key).get_secret_value() if openai_api_key else None
        self._record_llm_context(provider=self.provider_name, model_name=credential_cls.model_alias)

        output = ChatOpenAI(
            max_tokens=max_tokens or None,
            model_kwargs=model_kwargs,
            model_name=credential_cls.model_alias,
            base_url=openai_api_base,
            api_key=api_key,
            temperature=temperature if temperature is not None else 0.1,
            seed=seed,
            max_retries=max_retries,
            request_timeout=timeout,
        )
        if json_mode:
            output = output.bind(response_format={"type": "json_object"})

        return output

    def _get_exception_message(self, e: Exception):
        """Get a message from an OpenAI exception.

        Args:
            e (Exception): The exception to get the message from.

        Returns:
            str: The message from the exception.
        """
        try:
            from openai import BadRequestError
        except ImportError:
            return None
        if isinstance(e, BadRequestError):
            message = e.body.get("message")
            if message:
                return message
        return None
